description: This is a management command script for a Django project that seeds a CRM application's database with test data, including organizations, users, contacts, opportunities, cases, tasks, and related entities. It utilizes Faker for fake data generation, manages database transactions, and supports various configurable options for data volume and structure.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: A Django management command class responsible for seeding the CRM database with extensive fake data, including organizations, users, contacts, opportunities, cases, tasks, and associated relations. It supports optional clearing of existing data and various customization parameters.

methods.name: add_arguments(self, parser)
methods.description: Defines command-line arguments for configuring the seed process, such as number of entities, seed seed value, and options like clearing data.

methods.name: handle(self, *args, **options)
methods.description: Main entry point for the command; sets seed, initializes helpers, manages transaction, handles clearing data, and orchestrates the seeding process.

methods.name: handle_clear(self, options)
methods.description: Handles the --clear option, prompting for confirmation unless skipped, and clears existing CRM data.

methods.name: clear_data(self)
methods.description: Deletes CRM data entities in dependency order to avoid foreign key constraint issues, including invoices, tasks, cases, opportunities, leads, accounts, contacts, teams, and tags.

methods.name: get_or_create_admin(self, email, password)
methods.description: Fetches existing admin user or creates a new one based on the provided email and password.

methods.name: set_rls_context(self, org_id)
methods.description: Sets the Row-Level Security (RLS) context for database operations specific to an organization.

methods.name: seed_all(self, options)
methods.description: Coordinates creation of organizations and all associated data, calling specialized methods for each entity type.

methods.name: create_org(self)
methods.description: Creates a new organization with random company name, currency, and country.

methods.name: create_profiles(self, org, user_count, password)
methods.description: Creates user profiles within an organization, including an admin profile and additional user profiles with random roles and access.

methods.name: create_teams(self, org, profiles, count)
methods.description: Creates teams within an organization, assigning random profiles as members.

methods.name: create_tags(self, org, count)
methods.description: Creates tags for categorizing entities within an organization.

methods.name: create_contacts(self, org, profiles, teams, tags, count)
methods.description: Creates contact entries with random personal info and relationships.

methods.name: create_accounts(self, org, profiles, teams, tags, contacts, count)
methods.description: Creates company account entities with various attributes and contacts.

methods.name: create_leads(self, org, profiles, teams, tags, contacts, count)
methods.description: Creates lead entries with various statuses, sources, and potential contacts.

methods.name: create_opportunities( self, org, profiles, teams, tags, contacts, accounts, count )
methods.description: Creates opportunities linked to accounts, with different stages and probabilities.

methods.name: create_cases(self, org, profiles, teams, tags, contacts, accounts, count)
methods.description: Creates case records linked to accounts, with statuses and priorities.

methods.name: create_tasks( self, org, profiles, teams, tags, contacts, accounts, leads, opportunities, cases, count, )
methods.description: Creates task records linked to various parent entities, with priorities and due dates.

methods.name: _add_assignments(self, instance, profiles, teams, tags)
methods.description: Adds M2M relationships such as assigned profiles, teams, and tags to an entity.

methods.name: _weighted_choice(self, weights_dict)
methods.description: Selects a random key from a dictionary based on specified weights.

methods.name: _stage_to_probability(self, stage)
methods.description: Maps opportunity stages to approximate probability percentages.

methods.name: print_summary(self, elapsed_seconds)
methods.description: Outputs a summary of the seeding process, including counts and elapsed time.

methods.name: __init__(self, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: unavailable
